texts.as_from_device: Byasubirijwe kuri iki gikoresho, bivuye mu bufasha bwabitswe ku wa {date}.
texts.as_no_answer: Nta gisubizo kiri kuri iki gikoresho. Ongera ubaze uri kuri interineti, cyangwa uganire n'umuntu.
texts.as_why_allowed: Ibi biremewe kandi bishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
texts.as_why_confirm: Suzuma ibisobanuro, hanyuma wemeze cyangwa wange.
texts.as_why_fresh_check: Banza, isuzuma ryihuse ko ari wowe.
texts.as_why_hand_over: Umuntu cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa ufite uruhushya ni we ufata icyemezo, bityo byateguriwe bo.
texts.as_why_later: Ibi bisaba umuyoboro n'umuntu cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa. Bizategurwa byoherezwe igihe uzaba uri kuri interineti.
texts.as_why_network: Ibi bireba konti yawe, bityo bitegereje umuyoboro.
texts.as_why_never: Ibi ntibijya bitangwa, kugira ngo urindwe.
texts.as_why_not_registered: LynkAssist ntishobora gukora ibi. Si kimwe mu byo yemerewe gukora.
texts.as_why_role: Uruhare rwawe ntirubyemera. Baza nyiri ubucuruzi.
texts.case_opened: Ikibazo cyoherejwe ku bufasha. Ibisubizo biza mu Biganiro.
texts.demo_people_card: Ibice bya LynkAttend, LynkQueue na LynkSurvey
texts.demo_rate_title: Uruzinduko rwawe rw'uyu munsi rwagenze rute?
texts.find_or_do: Shakisha cyangwa ukore icyo ari cyo cyose
texts.find_or_do_hint: Shakisha ibicuruzwa, abakiriya, ibyatumijwe, raporo, igenamiterere n'ubufasha, cyangwa wandike igikorwa
texts.kp_state_confirmed: Byarangiye: utanga serivisi cyangwa umufatanyabikorwa yabyemeje.
texts.kp_state_failed: Ntibyakunze. Nta kintu cyishyujwe cyangwa cyahinduwe.
texts.kp_state_queued: Byabitswe kuri iki gikoresho kandi bitegereje koherezwa.
texts.match_ok: Imibare irahuye. Iki gikoresho noneho gishobora gukoreshwa.
texts.match_pick_note: Niba nta mubare uhuye, hagarara: hari undi muntu ushobora kuba agerageza kwinjira.
texts.match_pick_title: Kanda umubare ugaragara ku kindi gikoresho
texts.match_show_note: Umuntu uri ku gikoresho gishya akanda umubare umwe n'uwo.
texts.match_show_title: Erekana uyu mubare ku gikoresho gishya
texts.msg_never_ask: LynkOmni ntijya isaba ijambo ry'ibanga, kode cyangwa nimero y'ikarita yawe binyuze mu butumwa.
texts.needs_net: Bikenera murandasi: gusaba kwishyurwa no kohereza ibiganiro.
texts.never_blocks_person: Kwifasha ntibibuza na rimwe kugera ku muntu.
texts.no_articles: Nta nyandiko iriho kuri iyi paji.
texts.ntf_basis_opt_in: Wahisemo kubyakira. Ushobora kubihagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
texts.ntf_basis_safety: Hari umuntu ushobora kuba ari mu kaga, ni yo mpamvu bihora byoherezwa.
texts.ntf_basis_security: Bireba umutekano wa konti yawe, ni yo mpamvu bihora byoherezwa.
texts.ntf_basis_transaction: Ni igice cy'ikintu wakoze cyangwa wasabye.
texts.ntf_can_turn_off: Ushobora kuzimya ubu bwoko mu igenamiterere ry'imenyesha.
texts.ntf_cannot_turn_off: Ubu bwoko ntibushobora kuzimywa kuko bukurinda wowe cyangwa abandi.
texts.pin_locked: Iki gikoresho cyafunzwe nyuma y'imibare y'ibanga myinshi itari yo.
texts.pin_locked_how: Nta kintu cyasibwe. Gifungure ukoresheje kode yawe yo kugarura, uvuye ku kindi gikoresho cyinjiyemo, cyangwa ugarura konti yawe kuri interineti.
texts.pin_wait: Umubare w'ibanga si wo. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'amasegonda {s}.
texts.pin_wrong: Umubare w'ibanga si wo. Hasigaye kugerageza {n} mbere y'uko igikoresho gifungwa.
texts.ppl_checker_notice: Reba neza ko umugenzuzi uhitamo ari aho ukorera.
texts.presentation_only: Bihindura gusa uko ibintu bigaragara. Amakuru yawe akomeza kuba uko ari.
texts.shortcut_hint: Kuri mudasobwa: kanda / kugira ngo ufungure ibi.
texts.state_coming_soon_body: Iyi serivisi ifungura yonyine iyo umufatanyabikorwa wemewe amaze gusinya mu gihugu cyawe.
texts.state_error_body: Nta kintu cyatakaye. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa usabe ubufasha.
texts.state_maintenance_body: Iki gice kirimo kuvugururwa. Kugurisha n'ibyabitswe byose ku gikoresho cyawe bikomeza gukora.
texts.state_no_results_body: Gerageza andi magambo cyangwa ugabanye akayunguruzo.
texts.state_not_found_body: Aderesi ishobora kuba yarahindutse. Shakisha icyo ukeneye, cyangwa usubire ahabanza.
texts.state_offline_body: Komeza ukore. Byose bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho bikoherezwa igihe murandasi igarutse.
texts.state_permission_body: Saba nyir'ubu bucuruzi kuguha ubu burenganzira.
texts.state_sync_pending_body: Impinduka zawe zibitswe hano kandi zizoherezwa iyo murandasi igarutse.
texts.stay_offline: Guma utari kuri murandasi kugira ngo uzigame interineti
texts.support_connecting: Turimo kuguhuza n'umukozi wa LynkOmni Support.
texts.switch_side_group: Aho ukorera cyangwa iduka ryawe ryo kuri murandasi
texts.username_bad_character: Inyuguti a kugeza kuri z, imibare, utudomo n'umurongo wo hasi gusa.
texts.username_held_for_review: Iri rishobora gusa n'izina ryabitswe kandi rizasuzumwa.
texts.username_hint: Inyuguti 3 kugeza kuri 30: inyuguti, imibare, utudomo n'umurongo wo hasi.
texts.username_leading_or_trailing_dot: Akadomo ntigashobora kuba aka mbere cyangwa aka nyuma.
texts.username_rule: Rigaragara nka @izina. Ni iryawe ubuziraherezo; imihora ya kera ikomeza gukora niwarihindura.
texts.username_web_address_ending: Iyo mperuka isa n'aderesi ya interineti.
texts.view_owner_only: Nyir'ubucuruzi wenyine ni we ushobora guhindura uko igikoresho cyo kugurisha kigaragara.
texts.view_waits: Uburyo bushya butangira nyuma y'iyi ntambwe.
texts.weak_note: Murandasi idakomeye: igikoresho cyohereza igihe gishoboye. Ibyagurishijwe bibanza.
texts.why_override: Wahisemo uku kugaragara kuri iki gikoresho. Hitamo Byikora kugira ngo usubire inyuma.
texts.why_registered: Uku ni ko iki gikoresho cyanditswe mu bucuruzi.
texts.why_reported: Byahiswemo hakurikijwe ibyo igikoresho kivuga: ecran yacyo n'uko ugikoresha.
texts.why_safe_default: Iki gikoresho nticyatanze amakuru ahagije, bityo hakoreshwa uburyo bukorana n'ubwoko bwose bwo kwinjiza.
texts.writes_in: {name} yandika mu {from}. Ubutumwa buhindurwa mu {to} kubwawe.
